summary: Red-teamed the original H1/H2 project hypotheses against 2025–2026 literature. Found H1 broadly occupied by existing DP-vs-membership/topology auditing and H2 substantially occupied by neighborhood-aware unlearning and new unlearning attacks. Promoted a narrower H3: privacy of NRI-style latent interaction topology, grounded by older topology-privacy work in dynamical systems and a 2023 latent-graph privacy paper. Established a minimal 5-particle spring experiment scaffold and identified adjacency/release-surface formulation as the central unresolved issue.
termination_reason: A meaningful research-decision milestone was reached: project attention shifted from broad graph-DP/unlearning benchmarking toward a formulation-first latent-topology privacy question.
